title: Great Investors Love Watching Paint Dry | Mohnish Pabrai’s Fireside chat with Ben Graham Centre
description:
Mohnish Pabrai’s Fireside chat with Ben Graham Centre at the 5th European Value Investing Conference on October 14, 2025.

00:01:00       Cloning is the best mental model
